title: India's Digital Personal Data Protection framework

events.title: DPDP Act receives assent
events.detail: Act No. 22 of 2023 became law. Commencement of individual provisions was to follow by notification.

events.title: Draft rules published
events.detail: MeitY issued draft rules for comment, before publication of the final notification.

events.title: Final DPDP Rules notified
events.detail: G.S.R. 846(E) appeared in the Gazette. Its publication date is shown as 13 November 2025.

events.title: First provisions commence
events.detail: G.S.R. 843(E) brought specified preliminary and institutional provisions into force.

events.title: Second stage scheduled
events.detail: One-year commencement stage for section 6(9) and section 27(1)(d), as specified by G.S.R. 843(E).

events.title: Further provisions scheduled
events.detail: Eighteen-month stage for the remaining specified provisions, subject to subsequent changes.
